entities.title: Production
entities.summary: The chess Worker at icelander.net/games/retro/chess*, with the static game, the GameRoom Durable Objects and the D1 database chess.
entities.purpose: The game players reach at icelander.net/games/retro/chess/.
entities.deployedBy: By hand: the owner, or an agent the owner asks, runs `npm run deploy` in games/chess (npm test, npm run test:godot, npm run build, wrangler deploy) with Godot 4.7.2 and its web export templates, and a Cloudflare API token for the icelander.net account. Nothing deploys on a merge to main; the Deploy workflow was removed on 2026-11-23.
approvals: A pull request: main accepts nothing else.
The owner's say-so: only the owner, or an agent the owner asks, deploys.
entities.rollback: No rollback is recorded: check out an earlier commit and deploy it again by hand with `npm run deploy`. A database change is not undone by this; it is applied by hand and written so the previous code keeps working (docs/database-migrations.md).
entities.details: The Worker's route runs ahead of the games hub's less specific icelander.net/games/*. The Durable Object class GameRoom came with migration rooms-v1, which must stay. One-time set-up (the database, the login service's keys in ACCOUNTS_JWKS, and optionally Resend) is in the README's Deploy section and the runbooks.
